notes.title: Collect all the critters and more at Creature Collector Fest
notes.notes:
[h1]Fans of creature collecting games unite![/h1]

If you find yourself with the undeniable urge to rescue and collect every cute lil’ critter you come across in a video game, then the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/creature_collector]Creature Collector Fest[/url] is for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/a9e1a054baa2821e0b158ba5a952f291272d1928.png[/img]

Alongside a host of other adorable titles, you’ll find our own cosy offering - Critter Café. 

Escape to a new life in Gold Leaf Isle where, through a series of mysterious letters, you’ll find yourself tasked with rescuing adorable, fantasy critters in need of your help. Design and run your own café, care for your critters, uncover the secrets of mysterious portals, and create a wholesome café for all to enjoy!

[b]The event runs 12 May @ 10:00am PDT/19:00pm CET to 19 May @ 10:00am PDT/19:00pm CET.[/b]

And if you find yourself needing even more critters for your collection, the [b]Little Critters Festival[[/b] is also taking place from 13 May - 20 May, which we'll be featuring in. Keep an eye out for that one on Steam.

Happy creature collecting!

notes.title: Critter Café Update 1 - Full Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi friends! The first post-launch update for Critter Café, available on both Steam and Nintendo Switch, addresses a number of player-requested changes and introduces more quality of life improvements.  

We hope you enjoy the new update! The Critter Café team will continue to gather community feedback and keep you informed on any further planned changes.  

[list]
[*] Sprint Toggle option added. This allows players to enable an option for players to Sprint with a single button press, instead of having to hold a button down 
[*] Toggle options added for pushing/pulling blocks during puzzles, and for the coffee pouring minigame in Open for Trade  
[*] During Open for Trade, Critters will no longer block or impede the player when they are moving across the café  
[*] Selected portal puzzles will include additional guidance to help players complete them, following community feedback 
[*] In the Tutorials section of the Journal, further guidance for Bookings has been added to assist players on how to select the correct items 
[*] Updated the descriptions for the ‘Best of Friends’ and We’re All Best Friends Here’ achievements to clarify how to complete them. Players must interact with all Critters who have reached Max Bond and trigger the ‘best friends’ cutscene for these achievements to unlock  
[*] Roaming behaviour of Critters during Open for Trade has been adjusted, meaning Critters can seem livelier around customers  
[*] Added more settings to adjust the speed of the camera and floor cursor in Customisation Mode 
[*] Steam Deck: Fixes and improvements to controller behaviour when using an external controller 
[*] Steam Deck: Fixed issue causing only three columns to appear in the Critterpedia section 
[*] Fixed instances of Critters incorrectly floating after the ‘Max Bond’ animation is skipped 
[*] Multiple fixes and improvements to localisation and localised text on screen
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new update! The Critter Café team will continue to gather community feedback and keep you informed on any further planned changes.  

We'd love to welcome you into our cosy community over on  [url=https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC]Discord[/url]. You'll find announcements, surprises, and general cosy vibes on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://x.com/crittercafegame]X[/url].

notes.title: Critter Café Mailbox - Game Team Update: January 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/2106e686e1063a0256692504dc954865856ce729.png[/img]

Hey there everyone 😊 Following the launch of Critter Café at the end of last year, the game team wanted to share a short article with you on our first post-launch update.  

Firstly, a massive thank you to everyone for your support so far on Critter Café. It’s still incredible to see something that began life as a game jam prototype now available to the world, and enjoyed by many people. We’ve loved seeing your stories, journeys, and thoughts on the game, and look forward to seeing more! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/1afcb625fbb3b478fbb79b6c930ce60d6a6f59d5.png[/img]


We’re pleased to confirm that an update for Critter Café is planned to be released, simultaneously on Steam and Nintendo Switch, early this year. This update will focus on adding a handful of changes and options that our players have requested, either to improve the overall experience, or to further assist with accessibility. There will also be technical fixes to improve performance on all platforms and devices.  

Further assistance and guidance will be added in some areas of the game, including with Bookings, how to complete certain challenges, and with selected puzzles that our community highlighted as particularly difficult. Critter behaviour in the café during ‘Open for Trade’ shifts is also an area we plan to address, aiming to make them more lively around customers, whilst ensuring they no longer impede the player’s movement around the café. 

Also, we’re looking at adding toggle options for multiple actions that currently require the player to hold down a button or key, as well as more player choice for camera and cursor speed when customising spaces.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/5ad2b91f188c0b2a6d6010ad706ba5ec90c8af32.png[/img]


Work on this update is ongoing right now, and it’ll take a little time to finalise the changes and go through the required processes for updating on both Steam and Switch. Once everything is ready, we’ll share a confirmed release date, along with full patch notes.  

Please feel free to share questions and thoughts either here on Steam, or over on the [url=https://discord.gg/2kgsDDE5dU]Secret Mode Discord server[/url], where a dedicated Critter Café channel lives. Again, a huge thank you for your support. We’re excited to share more details soon!

notes.title: Mini Games in Critter Café - Opening and Serving in Your Café
notes.notes:
When Critter Café opens its doors on November 26 for Steam and Nintendo Switch, your very own café will be at the centre of a cosy, magical journey. But what good is running a café if it’s never open? Plus, how can you make sure you're serving the best possible eats and treats to your customers? In this post, let's take a closer look at how to run your café, so it operates as nicely as it looks!

When you decide the time is right for your café to be open for business, head over to the register at the back right of the café. Select the Critters who’ll accompany you on your shift, and get ready for some eager customers to arrive. Once you're Open for Business, you'll have a set amount of time to fulfil orders from folks in your café. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/11942951b91c25754377d3c76062788c75902ecb.png[/img]

Customers will raise their hands for attention, and it’s your job to take their order and fulfill their wishes with the following mini games:


[h2]Pouring coffee! [/h2]

Fill the cup of coffee up to the line for that perfect cup of joe.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f4a32da769660aa59fed2149203f7e6da7ecd686.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/a7d3df69953f605dfd6d33647cc6349a3d6637f9.png[/img]

 
[h2]Deliver treats! [/h2]

Remember the customer’s request and bring them food in the correct sequence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f232ec08ed8660012d5dfc8a3e4adfb0e514a366.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/002415aed44f37218c69540a921bfc2e3113e099.png[/img]


[h2]Latte art! [/h2]

Match the button presses to finish drinks with an artistic flourish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/d3895c56121f9e50bf91b40deb09e223ccfada10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/fd7623af6ab5c98f97e771dc427ec76bd8048841.png[/img]


[h2]Cake slicing! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/11942951b91c25754377d3c76062788c75902ecb.png[/img]

Cut slices of cake to match the requested portion size. Make mine a large one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/de25d53773cbb60898e558c0d4667606da6023e8.png[/img]


Every shift is ranked out of three stars. Master these mini games and you’ll delight your customers. But don’t worry if you don't get things exactly right: while your final rank determines how much EXP you earn, there’s no punishment for getting any orders wrong, and customers will be eager to come again the next time you open your doors. 

Join our cosy community on Discord, and follow Critter Café on TikTok, Instagram and X, as we head towards the grand opening of Critter Café on November 26!

notes.title: Critter Café – Creating the Cosy Café of Your Dreams
notes.notes:
Your magical journey in Critter Café begins – and centres around – your very own café. This lot of land on Gold Leaf Isle has potential, but needs plenty of TLC to turn it into a beautiful place to enjoy treats and tipples. 

From the very start of Critter Café, you’ll have the chance to design the café in your own image – and the more you play and progress, the more options for customisation and beautification you’ll discover. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/2f3839573f9f9d8820c25d9eb2498a6476a96764.jpg[/img]

Furniture will be critical to your café’s layout, as you provide customers with comfy and cosy places to sit. Choose between different table and seating options – some for 1-2 customers, and some for larger parties – with different styles and colours to pick from. Opt for an open social space with long tables and stools, or create small and secluded nooks for solo customers to get comfy. Go for a consistent theme throughout the café, or mix and match your tables, chairs and colours – the choice is yours. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/ff649d667a7601814c9b73e668b04fedaa5dcef4.jpg[/img]

Transform the aesthetic of your café by changing your wallpaper, placing pictures on the wall, and using lamps and lighting. Definitely make sure to switch out your curtains when you get into the café – the old ones look a little ragged. You can even place toys for Critters in the café, such as scratching posts and little shelters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/44b7d499e37255905917488be4c63cd348adad51.jpg[/img]

Remember – your options for customising your café will increase as your Critter Café journey goes on. Keep progressing, levelling up, and look out for ‘blueprint’ cards scattered throughout Gold Leaf Isle, to unlock new options on your way to designing the dream eatery for you and your customers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/eaf5d7610cc24a3df36e2cab93b7523d661b2df3.jpg[/img]

Finally, you don't have to pay to select or place any items. You're free to completely revamp your entire café at any time, without any restrictions. Make a new style for every season, perhaps? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/8e211e999d72bb44248b291f3f51969f8bbff61d.jpg[/img]

Phew – all this renovating is making us hungry! What’s on the menu? 

Critter Café launches for Steam and Nintendo Switch on November 26 (£15.99/$19.99). Can’t wait until then? Jump into the demo, available now on Steam! 

Join our cosy community on [url=https://discord.gg/2kgsDDE5dU]Discord[/url], and follow us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://x.com/crittercafegame]X[/url] for more game insights and news.

notes.title: Critter Café: How to Care for Your Critters
notes.notes:
Rescuing Critters is a rewarding challenge in Critter Café, deciphering puzzle-filled portals to discover a friend in need. This, though, is just the beginning of your story with a Critter! 

Once you’ve completed a rescue, you should head on over to Critter Café’s Habitat to meet up with your new pal.

The Habitat is where all your Critters reside. You can explore it to find your favourites, or use the bell by the entrance to call them to you. This is where you’ll see who is available to assist in your Café for the next shift. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/5337480829418accd745efd71f23e4bd002481f8.png[/img]

In the Habitat, you’ll also be able to play with each Critter, pet them, and feed them treats. These options will open and diversify, the more that you progress. Feeding Critters will replenish their energy levels if they’ve been busy at the café, ready to join you again to delight more customers on the same day, and to boost the experience they gain from activities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/903b122f14fb0a324bc949ee516ad758c503245a.png[/img]

Here in the Habitat, you can also adjust your Critters’ appearance. You’ll unlock different visual options for each Critter when you increase your bond through play and activities. Become 'Best Friends' to access a very special look! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/16d0c601cc58ed15c47c504eadd33cb429bdfb8b.png[/img]

Just like your café, you can fully customize the Habitat to make the perfect home space for you and your new best friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/048a302a8456f38526b5ed35c4c000f0110dcc6c.png[/img]

We can’t wait to see how you customize your Habitat to make it your own when Critter Café opens on 26 November, launching on Steam and Nintendo Switch (£15.99/$19.99). Want to meet some Critter friends now? Try out the demo, live now on Steam! 

Follow Critter Café on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/crittercafegame]X[/url] for more details, and [url=https://discord.gg/2kgsDDE5dU]join us on Discord[/url] for wholesome vibes and sneak peeks. We look forward to welcoming you!

notes.title: Rescues and Puzzles in Critter Café - Discover Portals and Save Critters!
notes.notes:
Critter Café is home to a wide variety of Critters, but you won't find all of them at your café from day one. That's because they've been trapped inside mysterious portals throughout Gold Leaf Isle, and it's up to you to rescue them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/07fdc855efb96da47c28830d9e735d9d25e1d0c4.png[/img]
 
Once you've earned a potion through managing your café, you'll be able to head out into the world and use that potion to open a portal. After leaping inside, you'll find yourself in a mysterious new area, with a whole new aesthetic. Think purple skies, ancient ruins, and twisting vines – not quite as cozy as the café! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/ee7c90e5b077d8cffb3998a4ee2de054d56256dd.jpg[/img]

To save the Critter within, you'll need to solve the portal's puzzle. Anyone who has played our Steam Next Fest Demo will know that some of these puzzles involve pushing blocks to clear paths and create bridges. They might seem simple at first, but they can get pretty fiendish over time. Expect new conundrums to overcome and progressively harder puzzles to unpick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/2abcca43bf5afe5d54687a106cc990d54199ec5f.png[/img]

You'll also have some tools on hand to help you navigate the portals. One key tool is your hammer, which can smash through amber that blocks your path. Perhaps you'll even find temporary power-ups for your hammer to help get through more troublesome problems. The more you play and progress, the more tools and useful additions you'll discover. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/0311ec2ea21d34255d357a001d392502a1e10201.png[/img]

Critter Café launches on November 26 for Steam and Nintendo Switch. Price will be £15.99 GBP/$19.99 USD. Want a taste of the cosy, magical world awaiting you? You can play the demo now on Steam!

notes.title: The World Outside Your Critter Café
notes.notes:
Chances are, you're going to be spending plenty of time in your cosy café when playing Critter Café, but there's an entire world to explore just beyond its doors! We don't want to spoil too much of what awaits you on Gold Leaf Isle, but today we're going to give you a glimpse of the places you'll discover come launch day on November 26, for Steam and Nintendo Switch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/9d81cdc2f7aacd8c931dc338e9077c785f47f2bf.png[/img]
 
The first area you'll travel to is Honeycrisp Grove, a lush green area full of cozy delights. Take a stroll through the beehives in the apiary, check out the apple trees in the picnic area, or get your steps in running around the fountain. If you get lost, there are signposts all around to direct you, or you can always check your map and see where you need to head next. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/3333982a839998fce5585af10efb6e6199a3a7ef.png[/img]

Honeycrisp Grove is also hiding a few secrets for those willing to explore a bit further! Rumour has it that new pieces of furniture for your café and habitat – as well as new clothing items for character customisation – can be found on cards scattered around the world. Make sure to find them all! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/cf3d295b9a83b6cba28ceb5d8c9db9471bc151bb.png[/img]

Potions are your key to uncovering the mysterious, puzzle-filled portals that Critters are trapped within. Once you've earned some potions at the café, you'll need to head to the wider world to find the portals. We think we saw a portal up by the fairy ring in Honeycrisp Grove... maybe you should check it out when you get a chance? 

That's just one area of Gold Leaf Isle, but there's so much more to see in Critter Café once the game launches on November 26 for Steam and Nintendo Switch (£15.99/$19.99). Make sure to join our Discord community to chat with our team and fellow players, and discover more by following us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/crittercafegame]X[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame]Instagram[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/9d81cdc2f7aacd8c931dc338e9077c785f47f2bf.png[/img]

notes.title: Customising Your Character in Critter Café
notes.notes:
Freedom of expression is everything in Critter Café. Not only can you customise your café to your liking; you're also free to switch up your own style whenever you like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/d514c9d11460316417b73dd848ad8afc093e44f4.jpg[/img]

By the exit to your café is a coatrack, which lets you enter character customisation. At any point in the game, you're free to head over here and change your look – there's no limit to how many times you change styles. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/53ec2ce16cd37540f57d25ed9d1aeeb02715cd73.jpg[/img]

You can change everything from your hairstyle and eyebrows to your clothes and accessories. Nothing is tied to a particular body type – every player can use whatever combination of items they like. Plus, new customisation items can be found by exploring the world outside of the cafe, so if you want to spruce up your wardrobe, go for a walk around! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/fbdfffc836c9e16a61e677b603d754de9e61c0ae.jpg[/img]

Not happy with the default colour of your clothes? Every item of clothing has a variety of colour options too, so you can completely customise your entire style. Whether you want to look sleek and stylish, cute and colourful, or something totally out there, the choice is yours. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f835aac0f5a2ab7152ce857a216ae9516fcfec42.png[/img]

We can't wait to see all the styles you create when Critter Café launches on 26 November for Steam and Nintendo Switch! Follow us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/crittercafegame]X[/url] for updates, and join our cosy community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC]Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/4b599c3ea7300fb3c91881b13098992ded93b7d1.png[/img]

notes.title: Starting a New Life in Critter Café
notes.notes:
So, where exactly is Critter Café set? How did the critters find their way there? And what's your role in all of this? 

We can't give you all the answers right now – you'll have to wait until the game comes out on November 26, for Steam and Nintendo Switch! However, allow us to share some of the details of what awaits you when you decide to open up your very own café...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/9989e7c2668fe044c16738708953e5f7696ba5fc.jpg[/img]

When you start Critter Café, you'll have just moved to the beautiful Gold Leaf Isle. Spurred on by some local pen pals, you start with a café that could do with a little bit of TLC. But it's not long before you'll discover a mysterious potion capable of opening strange portals, and meet your first fantastical critter... 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/6c64159750f8c82f8b4e258b2d78143aba8fa90d.jpg[/img]

From there, it's up to you how your story plays out. Maybe you want to focus on improving your café, making the best possible layout inside – or just the cutest café possible. Maybe you want to hang out with your critters and build up their bonds. Or maybe you want to explore more portals and save more critters. It's up to you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/ad492287d17a714c75d5053425e27bd9e5222dc2.jpg[/img]

Everything you do in Critter Café helps with your other activities. If you don't have any more portals to explore, try working in your café and bonding with your critters to unlock more potions. Mix things up every once in a while to fully enjoy your time in Critter Café! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/d4b681e73b588e341963de00962eb6ddbad05a4a.jpg[/img]

We're excited to see what stories you'll tell as you explore the world of Critter Café.  
 
Follow Critter Café on [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/crittercafegame]X[/url], and [url=discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC]join our community on Discord[/url] for more wholesome vibes and sneak peeks, as we head towards November 26. We look forward to welcoming you :)

notes.title: Critter Café Demo is Being Extended! Thank You for Your Support

Hey everyone,

If you're yet to play, and want the chance to run and renovate your own cute café, whilst rescuing and building bonds with even cuter Critters, now is your time. Or, if you've been playing the demo and just wanted a little longer to explore, customise and get to know your new friends, now you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f835aac0f5a2ab7152ce857a216ae9516fcfec42.png[/img]

If you'd like to know more details of what to expect in the demo before jumping in, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2367610/announcements/detail/4699033840168861048?snr=2___]you can check out our guide here[/url]. 

As well as the lovely repsonses from our cosy community, we've been overjoyed to see some glowing responses from the games media world. A [url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/simulation/just-when-i-think-ive-hit-the-peak-of-steam-next-fest-i-find-this-cozy-cafe-management-sim-with-cute-critters-and-strong-animal-crossing-energy-which-is-also-hitting-switch/]piece from GamesRadar[/url] says "Critter Cafe is my new obsession", and "Sumo Digital is cooking up an absolutely adorable game", whilst an [url=https://www.gamespew.com/2024/10/steam-next-fest-critter-cafe/]article from GameSpew[/url] states: "It’s the type of wholesome game that never feels like busywork, that combines simulation with adventure, and I can’t wait to see more."

Finally, we highly recommend checking out streams, VODs, and video round-ups of folks playing the Critter Café demo, including [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/vsgadKKCXjQ?feature=shared&t=1215]this video from Payton'sCorner[/url], who seemed to have a blast playing.

We can't wait to see more people play the Critter Café demo, rescuing more friends, brewing up more lattes, slicing more cakes, and discovering more mysteries, as we prepare for the full launch on November 26. Join us on Discord to chat about the game, and follow our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://x.com/crittercafegame]X[/url] channels to stay up to date!

notes.title: Critter Café Demo - What to Expect From October 14
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone, 

The entire Critter Café team is so excited to be a part of Steam Next Fest, and to be rolling out a demo for our game, available from October 14!  

This is your first chance to get an early taste of our cosy fantastical world, launching for Steam and Nintendo Switch on November 26. Whilst running and renovating your own café and serving treats to your guests, rescue Critters from mysterious puzzle-filled portals, and build bonds with your Critters to help make your café extra special.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/97d307aee75056677e21c902f07c4411890f7341.jpg[/img]


[h2]WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT IN THE CRITTER CAFÉ DEMO? [/h2]

The demo will include the first slice of the Critter Café experience, starting from the very beginning of the game. You’ll be able to play through the first handful of ‘days’ in the game, introducing you to key features and characters.  

You’ll have a chance to run your café for the first time, serving customers and fulfilling their orders via fun minigames. Also, you’ll be able to customise the look and layout of your café – from the furniture, to the wallpaper, to Critter toys  – with an early set of unlocked items.  

Away from the café, you will have the chance to find and rescue your first two Critters. Rescuing them will require solving puzzles, which sometimes require tools to solve. You’ll get the first of those items during the demo. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/ee7c90e5b077d8cffb3998a4ee2de054d56256dd.jpg[/img]

Once rescued, you’ll have the chance to build a bond with your Critters, discover potential traits that influence their behaviour, and even have them in your café, setting up bookings for guests to meet them. There are more features and mysteries in the demo, but we’ll leave those for you to discover! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/92ed2e5d438198a87eabf6534a13687ee285d3cc.jpg[/img]


[h2]JOIN THE CRITTER CAFÉ CLUB [/h2]

Please keep in mind that the demo is a work-in-progress snippet of the game, meaning some aspects may be incomplete, or you may bump into an issue or two. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367610/Critter_Caf/]Chat with our team on Discord[/url], or in the Steam Community area, if you experience anything you’d like to report, as we continue finalising the full game for launch on November 26. 

We’d really appreciate if you could [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367610/Critter_Caf/]Wishlist Critter Café[/url]. Doing so will also make sure you’re notified when the Steam Demo is available! Thank you, and please enjoy the Critter Café demo during Next Fest. Our team can’t wait for you to play 😊

notes.title: Critter Café Origins - Coffee with a Dash of (Game) Jam
notes.notes:
Did you know that Critter Café started out as a Game Jam project? 

It all started in the summer of 2022, when development studio Sumo Newcastle held an internal Game Jam alongside publisher Secret Mode. 

The brief was to create a game pitch for a title that would fit into Secret Mode’s catalogue, and gameplay programmer Eleanor Gregory (she/her) entered with a wholesome idea based on: ‘A cat café for fantasy animals’. 

Here is the very first design document she created for the project: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/1db17a55a9b0298601a1e9557ed4dedd5807d34e.jpg[/img]

Using this as a template, Eleanor then began bringing the idea to life as a playable demo during the Game Jam. The original demo started out as a first-person experience inside Unreal: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/6e424280994ae3c270fff2680f3b26c4655f8fbb.jpg[/img]

Say hello to the original design for Catcus!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/bf58fab21e1ad7d4d664fdec1021904f3a759865.jpg[/img]

The entry wowed the jury, and everyone at Secret Mode agreed that the world needed to experience Critter Café.  

After being crowned the winner, Eleanor Gregory joined a small team to start exploring the concept as a full game, and it’s from this point onwards that Critter Café began to take shape as the game you now know and love. 

As you can see from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EnJLCct1jmg]our recent trailer[/url], Eleanor's wonderful idea of a cosy, fantastic world has come on so much, and we can't wait for you experience the end result, when Critter Café launches on November 26. You don't even have to wait that long for a taste of the experience, as a demo for the game will be available as part of Steam Next Fest, from October 14!


Join our cosy community by Wishlisting Critter Café, and joining us on [url=https://discord.gg/2kgsDDE5dU]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@crittercafegame]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crittercafegame]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/crittercafegame]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Can't have a Café without Critters!
notes.notes:
What's a Critter Café without its Critters? If you've watched our [url=https://youtu.be/xxVNqNMYQ4c?si=JA0i1RCMoiJ85IRZ]announcement trailer[/url], you'll have seen a few of these adorable fantasy creatures already, either waiting to be rescued or helping around the café. Here, we're going to be looking at a few of them one by one, so you can get to know them a little better before you venture forth to save them. 


Mogbert is one of the very first Critters you'll find in Critter Café. They're very small, very soft, and very round. They don't even have legs! How does Mogbert get around the café? By hopping, of course! 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/61306cc72033c4d03826e45d794f4df1a2025890.png[/img]

Wobbleneck looks adorable from the front with their floral features. And what's that on the back? Another flower! Who needs floral arrangements when you could have Wobbleneck walking around instead? 

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f768b2fcb24135b17dcbdcc2b7975e88a054903a.png[/img]

 Fernitail is a four-footed fern with a fantastic little smile. With Fernitail and Wobbleneck wandering about, you should probably be careful where you put flowers – you might get confused about which one's a Critter and which one's a plant! 

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/06f824a8d4fd22e0bb5be716b3a53904289505f4.png[/img]

 Two legs, no arms, can't lose – that's Wabblebill for you. Guests at the café can be very particular about the number of legs a Critter has, so when a two-legged fan comes in for a coffee, it's time for Wabblebill to shine. 

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/4722152823afa643f2d30779d92b913306d7fdab.png[/img]

 Luvhen has a lot of love, and even more feathers. They even have a giant love heart on their chest! Their red feathers are certainly striking, but once they've built up enough trust with you, maybe they'll be ready to show off some new colours? 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/3e238be42aa021d2f9387c0f98587fe76d562c76.png[/img]

There are 35 different Critters to meet in Critter Café – who's your favourite so far?

notes.title: Customisation, Exploration and a Critter for Everyone
notes.notes:
Hi friends! We just know you're itching for more tidbits about our upcoming cosy game featuring adorable fantastical creatures known as Critters! Well, here’s some more info about what you can expect from Critter Café ahead of its release later in 2024. 

[u][b]Customise Your Character [/b][/u]

Express yourself! There is a big focus on customisation in Critter Café. With genderless character customisation you won't be locked out of any given cosmetic item based on your choices, so there’s endless possibilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/f835aac0f5a2ab7152ce857a216ae9516fcfec42.png[/img]

[u][b]Solve Puzzles[/b][/u]

Explore the mysterious rifts found around your new home and use magical tools to solve a range of environmental puzzles that increase in difficulty the more you explore. But don’t worry, there are no time constraints and no ways to fail. Push and pull blocks, activate switches and use your magical tools to work your way through the levels and closer to your end goal – rescuing a Critter!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/062cbed988f454a8730ba98ad544f7f54cd2a102.png[/img]

[b][u]Critter Rescue [/u][/b]

Critter Café is all about finding and rescuing adorable Critters and bringing them home to your café to bond with! After solving the puzzles inside each rift, you’ll find a new Critter waiting for you, and with 35 Critters to discover, rescue and bond with, there’s sure to be a Critter for everyone. We’re excited to see which one is your favourite.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/72f800cf1af0cc95340d9eccfc3155ffc9502883.png[/img]

[u][b]Serve Your Customers  [/b][/u]

Customers will come to your café to enjoy date nights, afternoon teas, karaoke and more. Arrange the perfect space for a booked event with Critters they’d adore, or open the café for general business and fulfil your customer’s requests for the best visit possible. You’ll also be able to show off your barista skills by making coffee and serving up some tasty treats through a series of easy-to-master mini games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/79c6a421357ce739d5236015de1a411bf9d6874a.png[/img]

[b][u]The Café of your Dreams [/u][/b]

Customise your café to a style you love with themed chairs, tables and decorations! As you grow your café, your new island home and its residents will provide inspirations for refurbishing your café and its magical sanctuary. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051973/981fda2fff54be74e449f6f1f617446cd55681e4.jpg[/img]

We're super excited to share more about Critter Café in the coming weeks. Wishlist it now to keep up to date with the latest news and updates. 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367610/Critter_Cafe/ 

Want to find out more?
